initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE production transparent game-prop sprite atlas for a top-down 2.5D Godot arena, requested 1536x1024 PNG, exactly THREE columns by TWO rows with six different isolated objects in row-major order.
Input image: Image1 is only the approved sunny option3 bright fantasy salvage-garden art/camera reference. Match its cream limestone, clean bronze/brass, teal glass, colorful crystals, refined hand-painted cel-polished colored outlines and warm welcoming daylight. Do not copy the scene, UI, characters or dark/rusted aspects.
Camera/style: every object is a real dimensional 3/4 OVERHEAD isometric game prop, camera elevation about35degrees, visible THICK TOP AND FRONT/SIDE FACES, fully readable solid volume with layered cel-painted surfaces, refined colored outlines. All objects same camera/light/material style. A small tight soft ground-contact shadow only. Complete object isolated on genuinely transparent alpha.
Layout: uniform3columns×2rows, exactly one object per equal512x512 invisible cell. All six centered individually with at least12%cellwidth/height completely clear transparent gutters on EVERY side; object+shadow fits within76%cellwidth/height. No overlap or crossing cell borders. Consistent projected base location near x50%, y75%cell. No outlines, labels or drawn grid. No extra ornaments detached from the objects.
Row1 LEFT B01_winch: fresh clean bronze/brass cable-winding machine, broad cylindrical spool wrapped with clean dark bronze cable, thick mechanical frame on short feet, handsome teal glass core in one side gear housing. Cream ceramic/limestone foot inserts. Complete crank, spool, feet. No rust or coal.
Row1 CENTER B01_ore_cart: clean bronze/brass and cream mining/salvage cart, chunky wheeled basket on four short dark copper wheels, filled with distinct faceted emerald-green, cyan-blue and purple crystals. Visible thick cart top rim and front sides, complete cart silhouette. No rail track or surrounding ground.
Row1 RIGHT B01_crate_stack: compact offset stack of THREE cream salvage boxes with brass reinforcing corners, thick visible top/front faces, small blue/teal/purple jeweled seals on box fronts, clean warm pale surfaces and short teal strap detail. Low stepped arrangement, no tall tower.
Row2 LEFT B02_spore_nest: low jade/teal glass and pale limestone bowl-shaped terrarium/nest, visible thick rim and bowl front, containing a few rounded CORAL/PINK fungi and small mint leaves. Bright clean friendly fantasy botanical machinery, not a dark infection blob. No floating spores.
Row2 CENTER B02_root_barrier: low living ivy-and-wood ancient ruin barrier, two short cream limestone feet supporting pale warm wood/roots with restrained teal/sage ivy and a few tiny white flowers. Long LOW readable side silhouette, visible thickness/top/front faces. Not a giant wall, not an overgrown dark shrub.
Row2 RIGHT B02_fungal_rock: compact low sage-cream limestone mound with visible solid thick front face and gently uneven top, carrying a few vivid MINT GREEN, CORAL PINK and BLUE fungi caps plus tiny moss tufts. Bright varied fungi colors, not dark grey/brown monotony.
Lighting/mood: even soft sunny ambient light, tasteful gentle highlights, bright welcoming salvage adventure. Avoid dramatic cast shadows.
Constraints: EXACTLY six complete isolated props and one transparent atlas. Truly transparent RGBA outside silhouettes/gutters, no rectangular opaque background or ground slab. No people/monsters/characters, floor, scenery, text/UI/grid/watermark, floating collectible glow clouds, smoke, rays or magic aura. No photorealism, heavy rust, coal pile, oppressive dark colors, flat top-down icon symbols, or cropped object parts.
final_prompt:

Asset type: corrected production transparent 3-column ×2-row game-prop sprite atlas,1536x1024 PNG, EXACTLY six isolated props for Godot.
Input images: Image1 is the EDIT TARGET atlas. Its RGBA transparency and clean six-prop layout are correct, though displayed RGB can look colored outside alpha. Image2 is the style reference: bright hand-painted cartoon fantasy classical ruins and magical steam technology, warm fresh vivid adventurous colors, high-camera3/4 near-isometric 2.5D, refined colored outlines.
Primary request: correct ONLY the TOP ROW's faction identity from generic salvage machinery into B01 辉砂虫族 / sunlit sand insect-clan ruin technology, with obvious tasteful magical insect/cicada/wing design cues and AMBER brood crystals. Preserve the six-prop layout and correct transparent alpha; keep the bottom B02 苔光菌灵 / luminous moss fungal-garden row's terrarium, ivy root barrier and colorful fungal rock almost exactly the same. Maintain clean complete thick top/front/side faces and elevated overhead near-isometric camera, slightly more illustrative/cartoon polish.
TOP LEFT B01_winch: replace the dark metal cable with warm ivory/sand-colored BUG-SILK strands winding around a clean BRASS tension spool apparatus. Replace its TEAL circular core with a clearly AMBER-GOLD translucent egg-shaped BROOD CRYSTAL seated in bronze/brass housing. Add unmistakable but refined CICADA WING-shaped support motifs, wing-vein engraving and small insect-shaped crest in its clean brass/cream supports. Still functional winding machine with complete short feet/crank, magical classical ruin craft, no rust or modern electronics. Friendly imaginative, not sinister or biological gore.
TOP CENTER B01_ore_cart: preserve the cart's cream/brass wheeled structure, replace most angular cyan/green contents with 4–6 clearly AMBER/ORANGE/HONEY-GOLD EGG-SHAPED faceted BROOD CRYSTALS, a few small cyan/purple multicolored jewel accents between them. Add subtle cicada wing/radial insect motifs to the rim and front seal. No real bugs or larvae, only beautiful magical egg-shaped crystals.
TOP RIGHT B01_crate_stack: preserve three cream/brass box shapes as clean insect-clan NESTING CASES. Replace generic square gem seals with small diegetic CICADA/BEETLE-WING sigil medallions set with amber brood jewels, keep one tiny turquoise/purple accent. Embossed wing veins on brass corner plates and tasteful silk clasp bands. Make the insect identity visually obvious without any readable words or labels.
BOTTOM LEFT B02_spore_nest: retain beautiful clean jade/teal glass terrarium with coral/pink fungi, pale stone/brass feet and mint leaves.
BOTTOM CENTER B02_root_barrier: retain LOW living ivy/wood ruin barrier with short cream stone feet, white flowers and warm wood roots.
BOTTOM RIGHT B02_fungal_rock: retain sage-cream limestone mound with vivid mint/coral/blue fungi and tiny moss.
Composition/framing: EXACT same three-column/two-row ordering, each complete object isolated with generous fully transparent gutters on all sides. Shrink whole props slightly if needed so no parts cross cell boundaries; keep full crank/wheels/leaves uncropped. No rectangular ground tile or opaque floor. Each object has solid dimensional volume and only a tiny tight contact shadow.
Constraints: preserve original clean pale materials and all six complete prop identities, no scenery/characters/extra figures, no text/UI/grid/border/watermark, no floating glow clouds/spores/smoke, no sinister infection palette or heavy rust. Use ACTUAL transparent RGBA outside silhouettes/gutters, no painted background. No shader recoloring substitute: re-draw TOP ROW insect-clan silk machinery, amber brood-eggs and wing-sigil shapes as real artwork.
canonical_steering: Final B01 changes replace generic teal-core salvage visuals with hand-drawn amber brood core, ivory bug-silk, cicada wings and insect-sigil nesting cases. B02 botanical props retained.
